description: Metro MCP provides free, live, read-only public transit information for Washington, DC and New York City. Check train arrivals, search stations, inspect service incidents and elevator outages, view bus and train positions, and look up NYC route details. The interactive Transit Board keeps results easy to scan, with text and structured fallbacks for other clients. No Metro MCP login, credentials, or purchase is required.

defaultPrompt: When is the next train at Metro Center in DC?
Are there delays or elevator outages on my DC trip?
Show nearby NYC subway stations and current arrivals.
